LenientU32.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer; accepts a JSON number or a decimal numeric string.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

RepeatSchedule.description: Regular sampling schedule, compiled into explicit offsets.

interval.description: Positive interval between samples, in frames.

ResetSignal.description: Public reset signal owned by the network, not an arbitrary script.

path.description: Stateful COMP exposing the reset Pulse.

SampleInspect.description: Structural reads at the same controlled capture sample.

include.description: Empty means nodes/errors/warnings. Content excluded for timed samples.

paths.description: 1..16 existing paths sharing the sampled clock.

TimingOptions.description: Sequential forward schedule; never seeks backwards or skips intermediate cooks.

initializeFrames.description: Initialization frames after reset (default 1 with reset, otherwise 0).

repeat.description: Regular schedule; mutually exclusive with sampleFrames/stepFrames.

reset.description: Public component reset pulse, optional when continuing prepared state.

sampleFrames.description: Strictly increasing offsets (1..16 samples, max offset 3600).

stepFrames.description: Advance this many frames and capture once; 1..3600.

timePath.description: Effective output time source; omit to infer from source.time.

timeoutSeconds.description: Local job deadline (1..600 seconds), default 120; not an RPC timeout.

warmupFrames.description: Additional sequential warmup frames before offset zero; default 0.

action.description: Start (default), status, cancel, or release a timed capture job.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

inspect.description: Optional structural inspection paired with each timed sample.

jobId.description: Job returned by a prior timed capture. Omit on status/cancel to discover the active job.

path.description: Operator path (OpPath; relative to contextPath or /project1).

timing.description: Optional reset and sequential advance schedule; omitted means immediate capture.
